alt: Grade 11 learners seeing key entrepreneurial qualities and the sections of a business plan
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 11 learners. On the left show a central entrepreneur silhouette with quality traits radiating outward (risk-taking, creativity, determination, leadership, innovation) as labelled spokes. On the right show a stacked list of business plan sections as coloured blocks (executive summary, market analysis, operations plan, financial projections). Use bright colours, simple flat design, clean white background, minimal text labels.
